crossRefs.note: He called the gatekeepers; and they told it to the king’s household within.
The watchman saw another man running; and the watchman called to the gatekeeper, and said, “Behold, a man running…
Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman…
“It is like a man, traveling to another country, having left his house, and given authority to his servants, and to…
Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming, whether at evening, or at midnight, or when…
For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots, and the sound of horses, even the noise of…
Therefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their donkeys, even the camp…

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

translations.web: So they came and called to the city gatekeepers; and they told them, “We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, not even a man’s voice, but the horses tied, and the donkeys tied, and the tents as they were.”
translations.bsb: So they went and called out to the gatekeepers of the city, saying, “We went to the Aramean camp and no one was there—not a trace—only tethered horses and donkeys, and the tents were intact.”
translations.kjv: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were.
translations.asv: So they came and called unto the porter of the city; and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but the horses tied, and the asses tied, and the tents as they were.
